feedback:
Approved to race as a single-variable test. The candidate is the iteration 5 baseline (best raced at 417.25: sensors at x = -0.05, -0.025, 0, 0.025, 0.05 and y = 0.07, sensor_size 0.012, kd 0.4, ki 0.5, base_speed 1.2, last_direction) with only controller.kp changed from 1.5 to 1.8. I checked the input against iteration 5 and the other fields match.

Why this is worth racing: iteration 5 is the only design that finishes the oval reliably (20 of 20). Its s-bend and slalom still leave the line. Iteration 7 (search_right) returned identical numbers, so recovery direction is not the lever. Iteration 8 (base_speed 1.0) is still unraced, so speed is not yet settled. Iterations 0 to 2 showed max_error near 0.061 whatever kp, ki or speed were set, but those runs had no derivative damping, so kp was never tested alongside the kd 0.4 that finished the oval (iteration 3). Iteration 4 (wider x spread) and iteration 6 (sensor_size 0.016) both hurt, so the geometry stays put.

Risk: at kp 1.8 the turn gain rises by 20 percent. The oval steering_oscillation is already about 0.21 (iteration 5), and the s-bend reached 0.30 there, so jitter could rise. Read the race in this order. (1) If slalom or s-bend progress rises above the iteration 5 values (0.19 and 0.56) and the oval still finishes at 1.0, keep kp 1.8 and consider a further step. (2) If the oval finish drops below 0.8, or oval steering_oscillation rises above about 0.3, return kp to 1.5. (3) If the tight tracks are unchanged, turn authority is not the limit. Then the next test should be base_speed 1.0 at kp 1.5 (iteration 8), or a single sensor y change, rather than more gain.
requested_changes: If slalom and s-bend progress rise above their iteration 5 values (0.19 and 0.56) with the oval finish at 1.0, keep controller.kp at 1.8 and try kp 2.0 with all other fields unchanged, since iteration 0 showed kp 2.0 was not unstable on its own.

If the oval finish falls below 0.8 or oval steering_oscillation rises above about 0.3 at kp 1.8, return controller.kp to 1.5 and keep the iteration 5 design as the baseline, since iteration 5 is the only design that finishes the oval reliably.
If the tight tracks are unchanged at kp 1.8, turn authority is not the limit. Keep kp 1.5 and test controller.base_speed 1.0 (iteration 8) on the iteration 5 geometry, rather than adding more gain.
